help.title: Help
help.edit: Select a question in the list to change its wording, make it required, move it or delete it. Yes/No questions can skip ahead when the answer is No.
help.undo: Every change can be undone and redone. Making a new change after undoing ends the steps you could redo.
help.preview: Preview walks through the survey as a member would answer it, skip logic included, without changing anything.
help.save: Changes stay on this page until you save a revision. Reloading the page returns to the latest saved revision.
